review_type: Assistant visual inspection of freshly decoded final v002 MP4 pixels
observations: The displayed range is 0–200 IN DECIMAL. The title and subtitle appear centered with clear separation.
All four numeric rows are legible. Eight binary digits at 128 and 200 fit the existing fixed type size without clipping, overlapping the label divider or reaching the panel edge.
Decimal 128 displays 10000000 binary, 200 octal and 80 hexadecimal. Decimal 200 displays 11001000 binary, 310 octal and C8 hexadecimal.
Opening wing poses, the ground-peck pose and the small hop retain the established bird size and natural-looking contour. No pose covers the panel or exits the frame.
The teaching marks at 8, 16 and 64 remain consistent. The decimal speech highlight clears during the teaching pause.
The finale retains 200 in all four systems before the intended cream fade. The last frame is fully cream.
No clipped title, labels or numeric glyphs, visibly enlarged pixels, broken outlines or panel collisions were observed in the inspected native frames and contact sheet.
limits: Native-pixel inspection is sampled; no claim of human viewing of every frame or full-duration playback is made.
The separate final verifier and technical report describe their complete decode and selected-pixel measurement coverage.
